lcc_original: 雅列在世的日子、共有九百六十二年，然後死。
notes: H1961 {<WAH01961>} and H8799 morphology were implicit in UNV; LCC '在世' explicitly renders 'to be/live' — braces dropped and tags attached to 在世 per rule 3.
H3117 {<WH03117>} was implicit in UNV; LCC '日子' explicitly renders 'days' (יְמֵי) — braces dropped and tag attached to 日子 per rule 3.
UNV has two instances of H8141 (שנה, year): one implicit after 百 and one explicit on 歲. LCC consolidates to a single 年, so both H8141 tags are attached there.
UNV tags H3605 only on 共; LCC uses 共有 as a compound expression — tag attached to the full 共有 phrase.
LCC 然後 (then/thereafter) is a Chinese connective with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
